---
title: "Week Results"
---
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
source("_data.R")
library(knitr)

for (w in sort(unique(weekly_summary$week))) {
  cat(paste0("\n### Week ", w, "\n\n"))
  
  week_detail <- results %>%
    filter(week == w, !is.na(correct_pick)) %>%
    select(User = user, Game = game_id, Pick = pick, `Correct Pick` = correct_pick, Correct = correct) %>%
    mutate(Correct = ifelse(Correct, "✅", "❌"))
  
  print(kable(week_detail))
  cat("\n")
}
```
